_about: The dashboard To-Do feed. Refreshed at every Rule 8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff — this is the handoff distilled into plain language for the 📋 button on every tab. Split For Sam (curation / decisions only a human makes) and For Fable (engineering, the next session picks up).
_as_of: 2026-08-21 · SkyVouch (Session 178) — Sierra was reporting three of LACCD's nine colleges; all nine were in the data and a cut-off in the code was hiding six. Fixed and live. The college/district crosswalk that had been built and never saved is now saved, including noncredit campuses and partner agencies, and there is a new College Identity tab that shows what is missing rather than just what matches — it already found two colleges whose CPL contact was invisible because of a stray space in their name.
_status: Three changes went live today. (1) Sierra no longer describes a partial list as if it were complete, and says outright when she cannot confirm a district's membership. (2) My College asks you to confirm your role when it was carried over from a previous visit, and its suggested questions now match whichever college or district you picked. (3) Every college, noncredit campus and partner agency now has its district, its state MIS code and all its known name spellings stored in one place, visible on the new College Identity tab. Waiting on MAP for two college IDs, and on Sam for a look at the new tab.

items.text: MAP needs to give us two college IDs. You ruled that Calbright and LAUNCH each have two entities — one credit, one noncredit. The noncredit halves already have IDs; the credit halves ("Calbright College Credit" and "Launch Apprenticeship Non-Credit") have none anywhere we can see, and MAP is the only system allowed to assign one. We deliberately did NOT make one up, because a fake ID would look exactly like a real one to every other system. They show as "awaiting MAP ID" on the College Identity tab. Once MAP supplies them, they fold in with no code change.

Take a look at the new College Identity tab. It lists every college and agency we track, its MAP ID, its district, its state MIS code, and every different spelling of its name we have ever seen. Its real job is showing what is MISSING — right now it flags 13 names that appear in a live table and match nothing. Two of those turned out to be a genuine problem: Cypress College and San Jose City College had a stray space at the end of their name in the contacts table, so both looked like they had no CPL contact when they each have a real one. Already fixed.

Re-ask Sierra the district question. You asked what LACCD should do and she answered about three colleges when there are nine — all nine were in the data the whole time, it was a cut-off in the code. That is fixed and live. She should now list all nine AND say plainly that she cannot confirm a district's full membership, because we do not store district membership anywhere she can read. If she starts stating district facts we have not given her, tell us — that needs an instruction, and the instruction list is full at 9 of 10.

Check the role prompt feels right. When your role is carried over from an earlier visit, the chip now shows dashed with a note, and clicking a suggested question asks you to confirm before answering — your question is kept and sends on the tap. It only asks once per browser session, not per question. If that is too often or not often enough, say so.

American spelling is now a project rule and a automatic check. You flagged that we drift into British spellings. Everything written this session is corrected, one piece of text you would actually have seen on screen included ("the programme is inactive" / "the curated catalogue"). There are 219 older documents still carrying British forms — we will clean each as we touch it rather than doing one giant rewrite, which would bury real changes.

Fix smoke test mode 7 so it stops failing on correct answers. It checks Sierra's reply by searching the sentences for a nearby college name, so a correct answer worded differently reads as a failure. It went red twice today on answers that were fine. Our own note already calls this "the last place still grepping an answer" — assert on what retrieval returned instead.

Turn more written rules into checks. Every problem fixed today was already covered by a rule we had written down — one of them by a comment 34 lines above the bug. The two rules that existed as automated tests were caught before release; the two that existed only as prose reached the live site. Go through the notes lane and ask which ones could be a test or a lint rule instead of a paragraph.
Twelve credentials are marked statewide in the adoption file but are missing from Sierra's catalog entirely, so she cannot find them at all. Carried from an earlier session and still open.

Please open the three public pages on your phone — the Fact Sheet, Sierra, and the Veteran Sprint map. This is the last thing no session can check: we are blocked from reaching the live site, so all of it is verified in a test browser only. On the Fact Sheet, scroll to Statewide CPL credit recommendations — each program area should sit on its own line with four labelled figures beneath it (Exhibits, Credit recs, Adoptions, Could adopt); before the fix the name printed on top of the first number and Could adopt was cut off entirely. On the Veteran map, the side panel with the college details and the two directories was being hidden completely on any phone — it should now sit below the map. On Sierra, the faint grey notes under the answer box should be readable. If anything looks cramped or odd, tell me and I will tune it.
